import numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import least_squares
E=df['eps'].values; TT=df['T'].values; S=df['sigma'].values
def model(p):
    return (p[0]*np.tanh(p[1]*E)+p[2]*E**p[3]*TT**p[4]+p[5]*E**p[6]*TT**p[7]+p[8]*E**p[9]*TT**2)
rng=np.random.default_rng(0)
out=[]
for k in range(100):
    p0=rng.normal(0,1,10); p0[1]=abs(p0[1])+0.1; p0[3]=abs(p0[3]); p0[6]=abs(p0[6]); p0[9]=abs(p0[9])
    try:
        r=least_squares(lambda p: model(p)-S, p0, max_nfev=1000)
        out.append((r.cost,k,r.x))
    except Exception as e:
        pass
out=[o for o in out if np.isfinite(o[0])]
out.sort(key=lambda o:o[0])
c,k,p=out[0]
print("best cost",c, "nmse", np.mean((model(p)-S)**2)/np.var(S))
print("params",np.round(p,4))
res=S-model(p)
print("corr eps",np.corrcoef(E,res)[0,1],"corr T",np.corrcoef(TT,res)[0,1])
